newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes 32 cents down to 14.45 ringgit/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes 32 cents down to 14.45 ringgit/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 32 cents to 14.45 ringgit ($5.73) a kg after players tracked overnight losses in London and tried to correct the domestic market's sharp rise this week, traders said.
"The LME (London Metal Exchange) was down and there were bids to adjust the high (domestic) premium in the last few days," said a dealer.

Traders said offers to sell outnumbered bids to buy by 123 tonnes to 28. Turnover was 63 tonnes against 41 on Thursday. The premium against London narrowed to $55 from $170, the traders said. -- Barani Krishnaan (603-2307509) ($1= 2.5240 ringgit).
